ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High macro-level contrast between low-intensity black perimeter/central band and high-intensity internal surfaces covered by intermediate-intensity orange-brown pixel clusters; approximate spatial ratio of light/orange to black is 4:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive contiguous orange-brown pixel regions covering approximately 80% of internal lobes; irregular high-intensity white blobs visible on mid-left and lower-right internal surfaces; low-intensity black banding concentrated at median notch and along entire trailing/leading edge boundaries; cluster of low-intensity focal spots on right distal tip.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression; interior angle estimated at approximately 65 degrees; notch depth is roughly 15% of total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular jagged boundary across the entire trailing edge; peak-to-valley amplitudes vary between 5-15 pixels; distinctive deep macro-indentation located near the distal tip of the left lobe lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly convex curvature along lateral margins; lobes sweep dorsally and laterally from the central peduncle attachment point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of low-intensity dark circular pixels located on the distal right lobe tip; isolated dark spots detected on the interior white patches of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Short, dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the lower-left lobe, oriented roughly perpendicular to the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Pronounced irregular tissue loss/indentation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe; pervasive yellowish-orange diatom colonization across the majority of the visible ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive orange-brown pigmentation film masking the primary white/black pigmentation pattern.
